name: 書誌と問いを並べた読書ガイド
prompt:
Correct the first image. Keep its successful white, two-column editorial layout and all Japanese content, colors and typography. Use the second image as the exact 390 × 680 native geometry and text authority. Make only these corrections:

1. Move the content up to the native anchors. The category and right heading begin at y=16, book title at y=58, illustration frame at x=16/y=170/164×138, first metadata rule at y=350, then metadata rules at y=440 and y=530. Keep the right chapter rows at their native y anchors: labels at 64, 140, 216, 292, 368, 444, 520, 596; question text at 88, 164, 240, 316, 392, 468, 544, 620. The final question must leave about 28 px of bottom margin as in the second image.

2. Replace the illustration with the exact flat original image supplied as the third reference. Do not redraw, reinterpret, add texture or shading, change its contours, resize its internal parts, recolor it, or crop it. Keep its pink circle, forest-green shapes and white cutouts exactly as shown in that image, placed in the same 164×138 frame at x=16/y=170. The first render introduced texture; remove it.

Keep the page pure white #FFFFFF. No tinted panels, row fills, pastel surfaces, gradients, colored shadows or glow. Keep reading questions and bibliographic values near-black #1D1D1D; chapter and metadata labels neutral gray #6E6E6E; forest green #1F6444 only for the category, book title, right heading and fine editorial rules. No color fill behind text.

Preserve Meiryo roles and original copy. Do not enlarge the book title or headings beyond the second image’s 20 px / 28 px Bold role, and do not shrink questions below 12 px / 16 px Regular. Use the exact content shown in the second image, with every Japanese character unchanged, all eight chapter/question pairs present, no additions, no omissions and no clipping. Maintain clean alignment, legible wrapping and the existing 390 × 680 canvas. The result is a single component image, not a device mockup or screenshot sheet.
reviewNotes: White/neutral page with no tinted fills; all Japanese content is visible. After one correction, the source illustration is still redrawn with texture/shading and top/bottom layout anchors remain low. Preserve the exact flat original artwork; residuals remain after correction limit.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
